title: Pizza Order — Question 3
prompt: What extra ingredient did the customer ask to add to the tuna pizza?
hint: Name the topping and mention it was added to the tuna pizza.
sample: They asked to add olives to the tuna pizza.

ja.prompt: ツナピザに何のトッピングを追加するよう頼みましたか？
ja.hint: そのトッピング名を言い、『ツナピザに追加するよう頼んだ』と答えてください。
ja.sample: ツナピザにオリーブを追加するよう頼みました。

local.prompt: What extra ingredient did the customer ask to add to the tuna pizza?
local.hint: Name the topping and mention it was added to the tuna pizza.
local.sample: They asked to add olives to the tuna pizza.

local_pron.prompt: What extra ingredient did the customer ask to add to the tuna pizza?
local_pron.hint: Name the topping and mention it was added to the tuna pizza.
local_pron.sample: They asked to add OL-ives to the TOO-na PEE-zah.

zh.prompt: 顾客要求在金枪鱼披萨上加什么配料？
zh.hint: 说出配料名称，并说明是加在金枪鱼披萨上的。
zh.sample: 他们要求在金枪鱼披萨上加橄榄。
